title: Schedule of Fees, Construction Loans
content:
The fees of the Construction Loans line are set per product: a plan review fee at application, an origination fee at closing stated as a percentage of the commitment with a dollar minimum, an inspection fee and a title date-down endorsement fee on each draw, a fee per extension stated as a percentage of the commitment, and a fee at conversion to permanent financing.

| Product | Plan and specification review at application | Origination fee at closing, % of the commitment | Minimum origination fee | Inspection fee per draw | Title date-down endorsement fee per draw | Fee per extension, % of the commitment | Fee at conversion to permanent financing |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Owner-Builder Home Construction Loan | USD 150 | 1.0 | USD 750 | USD 125 | USD 75 | 0.25 | USD 0 |
| Single-Close Home Construction Loan | USD 0 | 0.75 | USD 750 | USD 125 | USD 75 | 0.125 | USD 0 |
| Two-Close Home Construction Loan | USD 150 | 1.0 | USD 750 | USD 125 | USD 75 | 0.25 | USD 495 |
| Post-Frame Home Construction Loan | USD 150 | 1.0 | USD 750 | USD 125 | USD 75 | 0.25 | USD 0 |
| Farm Building Construction Loan | USD 250 | 0.75 | USD 1000 | USD 175 | USD 75 | 0.25 | USD 350 |
| Livestock Facility Construction Loan | USD 500 | 0.5 | USD 2500 | USD 250 | USD 100 | 0.25 | USD 500 |

## Definitions

- **Plan review fee** — Fee for review of plans and specifications at application, USD.
- **Origination fee** — Origination fee at closing, % of the commitment.
- **Minimum origination fee** — Minimum origination fee, USD.
- **Inspection fee** — Fee per draw inspection, USD.
- **Title date-down fee** — Title date-down endorsement fee per draw, USD.
- **Extension fee** — Fee per extension, % of the commitment.
- **Conversion fee** — Fee at conversion to permanent financing, USD.

## Points of reference

- No plan review fee is charged on the Single-Close Home Construction Loan (USD 0); the Livestock Facility Construction Loan carries the highest, USD 500.
- A conversion fee is charged on the Two-Close Home Construction Loan (USD 495), the Farm Building Construction Loan (USD 350) and the Livestock Facility Construction Loan (USD 500); it is USD 0 on the Owner-Builder, Single-Close and Post-Frame Home Construction Loans.
- The Single-Close Home Construction Loan carries the lowest fee per extension, 0.125 percent of the commitment; every other product carries 0.25 percent.
